items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: the first band we had a trumpet player called Harrison Gougie

ctx.x: That's in the Grittner. Oh. Go over to Grittner and play the Big Easy. Now like the first... Big Easy and they come clean. Big Easy and they come clean. See? And then they had another one over there called the number 12. See? Well they give dances every Saturday night. They hold about 50 people I believe. And they made money. You get a glass of beer like that for nickel, wine for nickel, sell you dinner. They made money. And everybody was happy. Well the first band we had a trumpet player called Harrison Gougie.…
That was Harrison Barnes or something?
